mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TBL_AI ( ANO, UNO, A_TITLE, A_TAG, A_CONTENT, A_REGDATE, A_SCORE ) VALUES ( SEQ_ANO.NEXTVAL, #{uno}, #{aTitle}, #{aTag}, #{aContent}, SYSDATE, #{aScore} )
mapper.select: SELECT A_TITLE FROM TBL_AI WHERE A_TITLE LIKE #{baseTitle} || '%'
SELECT ANO, UNO, A_TITLE AS aTitle, A_TAG AS aTag, A_CONTENT AS aContent, A_REGDATE AS aRegdate, A_SCORE AS aScore FROM TBL_AI WHERE UNO = #{uno} ORDER BY A_REGDATE DESC
